_doc.description: Shows hub slice of The T content. Rendered by src/web/features/theT/components/HubPage.tsx via the `shows` entry in `SLUG_RENDERERS` in src/web/features/theT/containers/Hub.tsx. Mirrors the conventions in homePage.json / comingSoon.json — field names mirror the canonical Static Upload Tubi Blog data so this file can be regenerated from the source JSONs without renaming, and section chrome (`{section}.header.title` + `{section}.header.subtitle`) is authored alongside the slot data so the same JSON drives both heading and content.
_doc.source: Hero copy is editorial, authored alongside the Shows hub Figma mockup — no upstream record carries this lede yet. Article-driven sections (added in subsequent passes) will pull from the same `~/Desktop/Static Upload Tubi Blog/{listicles,single-titles}.json` slices the other surfaces use.
_doc.doNotInclude: intro, items[], cast[], whatsComing[] — only the fields the Shows hub actually renders should ship in this chunk.
_doc.linking: Every article card / hero uses the canonical URL `/the-t/articles/<slug>`. Each slot stores just the bare `slug`; the renderer (`homePageData.ts → buildArticleHref`) prepends the prefix. The optional `watchLink` on some slots is reserved for CTAs that bypass the article and route straight into the Tubi catalog; it does NOT influence the article href.
